items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: He wasn't that close a friend, but still I used to see him quite often in New York.

ctx.x: Unfortunately, I never answered his last letter. I wish I had now. I have it someplace here. I owe hundreds of letters, actually. But he wrote me, oh, roughly 1958 or something along in there. And he was still in New York. I had written him a few off and on through the years. I would occasionally hear from him. He was reviewing records, but I hadn't heard anything about him or from him, of course. It's been, oh, 15 years or so now. He may not even be living, I don't know. But some of these days I'll try to find…
Bubber at this time would be playing in New York?
